'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Tom Hollingsworth LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingsworth]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Inventory Hollingworth; sheet Hollingsworth. Title Originality.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Hollingsworth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
